ms.report:
Please find linked below the POA for Milestone 1.
There are a lot of moving parts like website design, integration of community feedback and the API from future milestones. Expect the look&feel and user convenience to change substantially as we put those together. Ideally, website and Github will become one single “portal” to deliver the best experience to technical and non-technical users alike.
To help with understanding the utility we have decided to add IPython notebooks for the milestones which can be run from any scientific Python distribution like Anaconda or the command line (>>ipython) or after downloading the files from Github where there is a “casestudy” folder. ms.report:
Here is the list of all outputs delivered for Milestone 3:

(1)All 10 selected native tokens with complete, clean time series.
We have provided a total of 18 native tokens time series with added 8 as bonus here:
https://github.com/Sapient-Predictive-Analytics/dataportal/tree/main/tokens
Information about data cleaning and utility handler functions for outlier detection:
https://github.com/Sapient-Predictive-Analytics/dataportal/blob/main/tokens/cleanData.md

(2)API fully functional with documentation
All 18 tokens plus custom signals are available via our API:
https://github.com/Sapient-Predictive-Analytics/dataportal/blob/main/api/documentationAPI.md
Any community user with terminal and internet access can use the API free of charge, but data limits are quite strict during the MR process as this milestone module is located in the public domain. For added security, we have put an API Key requirement and the key is in the chat of the Milestone module (--> Discussion at the bottom of MR module)

(3)Incorporation of community feedback
By request from community members, we have created a permanent Google form for feedback, requests and user input. This has been added to the repo and website for easy reference, with links throughout.
Feel free to contribute anonymously, we read all submissions at least weekly.
https://forms.gle/H1fMqNMmyYhaVepV6
We added candlestick charts of 12 tokens to the website as requested
https://www.sapientswarm.com/cardano.html
and added more Python inline code throughout the repository to be compatible with the Genius trading bot API tooling for Python trading community
(https://github.com/geniusyield/strategy-executor)
for example here in this new backtesting Part 2 section:
https://github.com/Sapient-Predictive-Analytics/dataportal/blob/main/backtesting/backtesting2.md
